name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
steps: Stand upright with feet together.
Extend one leg forward, resting your heel on a low surface.
Hinge forward at the hips while keeping your back straight.
Hold the stretch, then switch legs.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
steps: Extend one arm forward with palm up.
Use the other hand to gently pull the fingers downward.
Hold the stretch, then switch arms.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
steps: Stand tall and balance on one leg.
Grab the ankle of the other leg and pull it toward your glutes.
Keep knees close together and hips forward.
Hold the stretch, then switch legs.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Bring one arm across your chest.
Use your other arm to gently press it closer to your body.
Hold the stretch, then switch arms.

name: Cat–Cow Flow
steps: Begin on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Arch your back up toward the ceiling (Cat).
Then slowly drop your belly down while lifting your head and tailbone (Cow).
Repeat for several cycles.

name: Chair Quad Stretch
steps: Stand behind a chair and hold the backrest for balance.
Grab one ankle and pull heel toward glute.
Keep knees together, hold; switch legs.

name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
steps: Lie on your side and bend the top knee.
Grab the top ankle and gently pull heel toward glute.
Keep hips stacked; hold; switch sides.

name: Knee-to-Chest
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Bring one knee toward chest and hold behind the thigh or shin.
Keep the other leg relaxed; hold; switch sides.

name: Shoulder External Rotation (Doorway)
steps: Stand near a doorway with elbow at 90° by your side.
Gently rotate forearm outward while keeping elbow tucked.
Hold a light stretch; relax and repeat.

name: Shoulder Rolls
steps: Stand tall with arms relaxed at sides.
Roll shoulders up, back, and down in smooth circles.
Repeat forward circles.

name: Shoulder Raises (Mobility)
steps: Stand tall with arms at sides and palms in.
Raise arms to shoulder height with control.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Standing Forward Bend
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips, letting head and arms relax toward floor.
Soften knees as needed; hold and breathe.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
steps: Extend one arm forward with palm down.
Use the other hand to gently pull fingers toward you.
Hold; switch sides.

name: Resisted Wrist Extension (Light)
steps: Hold a light band or weight with palm down.
Extend wrist upward against resistance.
Lower slowly; switch sides.

name: Standing Squat Hold
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat position, keeping chest tall and knees behind toes.
Hold at the bottom; push through heels to rise.

name: Standing Calf Stretch
steps: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward, one back.
Press back heel into the floor while leaning slightly forward.
Hold; switch sides.
